pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with predominantly smooth edges and rounded vertices. Individual dark regions on the flank show a higher spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches at the base of the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored corridors forms a topological web. Junction nodes typically consist of 3-way or 4-way intersections. The pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the visible mid-section of the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, short-bristled mane is visible along the dorsal ridge, creating a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the light background.
